description: The quick simulation (expected values from the spec, instant): what each box, ticket and craft gives back against its price, the house edge, each pool’s money in and out per day and whether it runs dry, settles or grows, farm rewards per unit staked, what players, the treasury and the platform get each day; a box’s chances with its odds rules at their most, what a box that gives nothing for a miss misses as its outcomes run out, what a ticket weighs in a lottery weighed by time, and what places get from a pool that starts short. `scenario` overrides the spec’s own ({"perDay": {"box:flip": 1000}, "days": 30, "staked": {"<farm>": 1000}}). Quote its numbers; never your own arithmetic.

example.description: A worked example by name, from xsolana_examples (coin-flip-arena, stud-farm, …).

scenario.description: What to assume instead of the spec’s scenario.

spec.description: An economy spec (version 2) given inline. Takes precedence over file and example.

name: xsolana_simulate
